passages.note: Bill details page lists Rep. Joanna King as a co-author of HB 1041 (2022), designating girls' teams as female-at-birth only.
passages.actor_quote: Rep. Chris Jeter, Rep. Joanna King, Rep. Robert Heaton

passages.provision_quote: A male, based on a student's biological sex at birth in accordance with the student's genetics and reproductive biology, may not participate on an athletic team or sport designated under this section as being a female, women's, or girls' athletic team or sport.
passages.note: Enrolled bill text bars a male, based on biological sex at birth, from a team designated female/girls', matching rung 4's clause.
Roll Call 402 (May 24, 2022) shows King voting Yea to override the governor's veto of HB 1041, enacting the law.
passages.tally_quote: Yea 67 Participation in school sports. (2022) Nay 28 Excused 5 Not Voting 0

rows.reasoning: King co-authored HB 1041 (2022) and voted Yea on Roll Call 402 to override the governor's veto, enacting a single-subject law that bars a male based on biological sex at birth from participating on a female/women's/girls' designated team, matching rung 4's text, 'require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth.' The 28-67 tally is not near-unanimous.
